name: Raphael Badalov
summary: Raphael Badalov (IG @byraph) is a client who came in on 2026-07-18 after his Instagram was disabled over copyright/DMCA strikes and content removals, plus a messaging restriction flagged under Meta's fraud/deceptive-practices policy. He paid ~$10K in crypto (Kraken) — well above the usual ~$4-4.5K unban rate — largely to learn who reported/banned him, and spent much of the thread pressing for proof (DMs/chats) naming the person. He got unbanned (says he did it himself on 7/19) but still wanted the strikes cleared and removed posts restored, then moved on to asking about legacy verification, custom verification, and buying short usernames (@real, @raph, @truth, @paid, @rb). Relationship survived a falling-out with a former partner (owner separated from him on 7/29); Raph is still open to more business.
key_facts: IG handle @byraph; real name shown on Meta restriction screen as Raphael Badalov
Paid ~$10,000 in crypto via Kraken (said he shorted the payment by $7) — normal unban rate quoted around $4,000-$4,500
Offered escalating amounts ($7K → $8K → $12K) for proof of who reported/banned his account; wanted DM screenshots, owner never fully delivered
Ban was copyright/DMCA-related; claims ~40 Meta emails carrying strikes
Meta added a messaging restriction 7/19/2026 (can't send messages until 8/18/2026) under fraud/scams/deceptive practices
Two posts removed 7/16 for guideline violations, including a Carti pic — wanted posts and strikes cleared, not just the account back
Says he got unbanned himself on 7/19 but asked owner not to post about it
Claims to already have shield; asked about legacy verification
Distrusts Telegram vendors ('they rape and scam'), prefers dealing directly
Name-drops mutual contacts: Bau (close friend), Brian, Roy, 'Legos'; says the owner charged 4500 or less for his guys
Says he feeds his family with his IG; NJ area code (609)
On 7/29 owner explained he separated from a former partner to avoid liabilities; Raph accepted and relationship intact
services_discussed: Identifying who reported/banned an account (ban-source intel)
